source: Modern ZXNAME0000XZ-based embedding models therefore fine-tune foundation models for embedding tasks rather than assuming the base model’s hidden states already form an ideal retrieval space. Qwen3 Embedding, for example, trains the foundation-model backbone with a contrastive objective and a defined readout. [18]
zh: 因此，现代基于 ZXNAME0000XZ 的嵌入模型对嵌入任务的基础模型进行了微调，而不是假设基础模型的隐藏状态已经形成了理想的检索空间。例如，Qwen3 Embedding 通过对比目标和定义的读数来训练基础模型主干。 [18]
